title: Nourishing Spicy Tunisian Lamb Wrap
description: A flavorful and nutritious dish featuring lamb, Cajun spices, and low-glycemic ingredients, wrapped in a festive Tunisian style, this spicy lamb wrap is perfect for a satisfying lunch or dinner, with a mix of grassy herbs and molten cheese, inspired by ssam-wrap traditions.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat, adding the olive oil to coat the bottom.
Add the lamb strips to the skillet, cooking until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the Cajun spice mix to the skillet, stirring to coat the lamb evenly.
Add the sliced onion and bell pepper to the skillet, cooking until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Warm the low-glycemic wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spooning the lamb and vegetable mixture onto the center of each wrap, topping with feta cheese and parsley.
Drizzle the lemon juice over the filling, then fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling, folding in the sides and rolling the wrap into a tight cylinder.
Serve the wraps immediately, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
